content.short: Goombles enable people to indulge in the sweet moments life has to offer.
content.description:
Our goal is to bridge the gap between web2 and web3 via gaming and physical products! Goombles are delicious and loveable candies living on the Cardano Blockchain.

Goombles come in various shapes and sizes while also doubling as your ticket to unlock exclusive perks, events, future drops, activities, content, games, physical products, and much more! It is said that owning each type of Goomble will yield a sugary surprise! We are building a fun-first 3D Tower Defense game.

Goombles is NOT a play-to-earn game, but rather a game that leverages blockchain technology as the "icing on the cake!"
